summary: The whole transport half of the file is stated over `[Field k] [AddCommGroup V]` although nothing in it uses either — the same conjugation identity is proved in the sibling `Clifford/Basic.lean` at `[Semiring k] [AddCommMonoid V]`, and every Mathlib ingredient (`asModule`, `asSubmodule`, `inv_self_apply`, `LinearEquiv.finrank_eq`) is available there. Two auxiliary results are general module facts dressed as representation lemmas, and one lemma re-proves an existing more general one.
